name: OST
description:
OST is decentralized digital cash and uncensored internet for 8 billion human beings — and eventually, beyond. Private. Instant. Unstoppable. The currency of Earth & Space.

Zero fees forever. Native confidential transfers (Token-2022). Human + AI Prediction Markets. Multi-layer resilience (on-chain + offline + satellite). Public Benefit Corporation — patents held for humanity.

From private money to free intelligence. From Earth to Mars. From atoms to self-constructing civilizations.
